main.text: Two board games. Open a link, and play.
Shadow Hunt and Game of Trades. Both run in a browser tab. Pass one screen around the table, or play online.
In Shadow Hunt, one player is the Phantom, hidden on a city map. Everyone else hunts together. On one screen, a pass screen hides each turn.
On set rounds, the Phantom is shown on the map for a moment.
Game of Trades is a build and trade game for three to eight players. Place settlements and roads, then roll for resources.
Online, the host opens a room and shares a five character code. Friends join from a link.
Each player is sent only what their seat may see. On the left, the Phantom's own screen shows his piece. On the right, a detective's screen does not.
To play, open the link. There is no account and no install. The host's browser runs the game, so host with people you trust.
The live link and the code are on screen. Thanks for watching.
